methodologyNotes: Roster of 12 current LED aquarium fixtures spanning planted, reef, and general freshwater use, re-verified against manufacturer stores (Kessil, Aqua Illumination, Current USA, Twinstar/Bluviva) and specialist retailers (Bulk Reef Supply, BucePlant, WorldWideCorals, AquaCave, SaltwaterAquarium.com) for price and headline-spec corroboration. Adversarial re-check corrections this pass: Twinstar S-Line V 600S price $323.24->$229.99 (BucePlant US ladder); Fluval Marine 3.0 price null->$259.99 (AquaCave live); Fluval Plant 3.0 price $124.21->null (Walmart source bot-gated, uncorroborable) and its per-depth PAR chart nulled (exact figures not corroborable); Twinstar PPFD@20cm dropped, leaving confirmed 4,100 lm. fits_length_range_in is a fixture-length/tank-width string in inches (cm noted where that was the source unit); point-source pendant fixtures (Kessil A360X, AI Prime 16HD, NICREW HyperReef) report a footprint instead of a linear range. control and programmable_schedule describe the light's native in-box control surface only; optional app dongles/controllers sold separately (e.g. Kessil WiFi Dongle) are not counted as app control. Prices/specs that could not be reconfirmed on live reachable pages (NICREW ClassicLED Plus, Finnex ALC, Beamswork DA FSPEC, hygger per-tier, Fluval Plant price) are left null rather than estimated. accessedAt 2026-08-19.

products.name: Fluval Plant 3.0 Bluetooth LED (32W)
products.priceNote: Walmart lists a 32W model for 24-34in tanks, but the live USD price could not be reconfirmed on any reachable page this pass (Walmart source is bot-gated); $124.21 in the draft is unverifiable, so nulled. Other sizes (22W/46W/59W) priced separately.
products.provenance: Product existence, 32W/24-34in tier, and Bluetooth-app control (manual/auto/pro modes, gradual sunrise-midday-sunset-night cycle) confirmed via ModestFish's independent PAR-tested review, which also confirms the Plant 3.0's exceptionally high relative PAR qualitatively ('more than twice the next closest competitor'). The Walmart source is a real Fluval Plant 3.0 32W listing but was unreachable (bot gate) this pass, so the $124.21 price could not be reconfirmed and is nulled. The specific manufacturer PAR-at-depth figures (545/270/113/71) could not be corroborated numerically on reachable pages and are nulled. Mounting hardware type not stated, left null.
